title: Procedural Archipelago — Double-Precision Coordinates
description: Procedurally generates a rocky island archipelago placed at real-world UTM Zone 32N coordinates (~6.55 million metres northing). All geometry vertices stay within single-precision range; only the SceneModel origin carries the large double-precision world offset. The renderer uses Relative-To-Centre (RTC) tiling so orbiting close to cliff faces is jitter-free regardless of the enormous absolute coordinates. Rock formations are geometry-instanced across all islands to minimise GPU memory use.
